name: BBC Learning English (YouTube)
description_short: BBC's official YouTube channel for English learners — weekly video lessons including the long-running 6 Minute English series, covering vocabulary, pronunciation, and listening.
teacher_note: 6 Minute English works well as a lesson centrepiece — short enough to watch together and discuss without eating the whole session.
creator: BBC
internal_notes: Verified active as of Sept 2026: channel confirmed live with weekly uploads including 6 Minute English (published Thursdays). Free to watch, no login required (YouTube account only needed to comment/subscribe, not to view). cefr_level/age_group left unknown — content spans multiple levels with no single site-wide claim.
